name: Bartimeus Bartimaeus
overview: The Scriptures introduce Bartimaeus as a blind man sitting by the roadside begging near Jericho, highlighted in Mark 10:46 and Luke 18:35. His presence at this location, as Jesus and a large crowd depart Jericho (Matthew 20:29), sets the scene for a significant encounter. This brief but profound mention underscores the reality of physical blindness and the opportunity for divine intervention through Christ's ministry.
